resolution.note: a MERGED PR at another head than the shipped one exits 77; ship.test.ts regression fails before, passes after

title: Ship reports a merge only when the merged PR's head is the shipped head
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-rerun-report.md (GPT-6.2 Astra rerun on 075e12b), verified by a read-only reader 2026-11-17.
Evidence: src/ci/ship.ts:769 accepts state MERGED and returns the merge commit with no head comparison.
Outcome: a MERGED PR whose headRefOid differs from the local shipped HEAD is refused (exit 77), never reported as merged.
Proof: a regression test at the lowest layer fails before the fix and passes after.
